entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
I need to make a return.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. Look, I'm short on time. Can I return this jersey or not?
Of course. Let me just pull that up for you... Okay, I see the order from December 31st. Just to confirm, this is for the Men's Aero Jersey?
That's the one. It's the wrong size.
I understand. So I can process this correctly for you, what specifically is the issue with the fit? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just too tight. I can't even zip it up. I need to do an exchange for a larger size.
Not a problem at all. Since the jersey was delivered only a week ago, you're well within our 90-day return policy. I can process that exchange for you right now.

And I see you're a VIP member with us. To make this faster, I've just emailed you a pre-paid return label and I've upgraded the shipping on your new size to complimentary overnight. You'll have it tomorrow.
Okay, that's great. So you're sending the Large?

Yes, a new order for the jersey in size Large is confirmed and will ship out today. You can just drop the original one in the mail with that label when you have a moment. Is there anything else I can do for you?
You're very welcome. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer, and have a great day.
